name: Fairmont Tremblant
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out Fairmont hotel at the base of the Tremblant peaks in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec
best_for: Families and groups who want rooms with sofa beds and full kitchens

facts.text: The hotel sits at the base of the Tremblant peaks.
Guest rooms have views of the mountain, the pedestrian village or the surrounding woodlands.
Fairmont Gold includes complimentary breakfast and afternoon canapes.
Many rooms have sofa beds and full kitchens.
The hotel has a Terrasse Apres-Ski for drinks with mountain views.
The hotel has an outdoor pool terrace with hot, cold and relaxing experiences.
The hotel has a spa called Moment Spa.
Choux Gras Brasserie Culinaire is a restaurant at the hotel offering a three-course table d'hote.
Breakfast is served at Le Comptoir.
The hotel is at 3045 Chemin de la Chapelle in Mont-Tremblant, Quebec.
Condé Nast Traveler lists Fairmont Tremblant in its Readers' Choice Awards for 2021 through 2026.

highlights.text: The lobby has soaring wooden beams and stone walls, with a fireplace.
Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience at the property.
Apres-ski activities include a slope-side hot tub and an outdoor DJ.
The First Tracks program gives guests early access to the slopes before the mountain officially opens.

considerations.text: Parking is available for an additional fee.
WhataHotel notes the remote mountain location requires a drive from Montreal.
WhataHotel notes peak ski season and holiday periods command premium pricing.
